title: A blank, short, long or taken matrix name keeps the old name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click matrix A's name.
  4. Clear the name.
  5. Click outside the name field.
  6. Click matrix A's name.
  7. Type ab.
  8. Click outside the name field.
  9. Click matrix A's name.
  10. Type matrix B's name.
  11. Click outside the name field.
  12. Click matrix A's name.
  13. Type a name of 128 characters.
  14. Click outside the name field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The field is empty.

Step 5:

  • An inline error shows under the name.
  • The title keeps matrix A's name.

Step 6:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 7:

  • The field shows ab.

Step 8:

  • An inline error shows and the title keeps matrix A's name.

Step 9:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 10:

  • The field shows matrix B's name.

Step 11:

  • An inline error shows and the title keeps matrix A's name.

Step 12:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 13:

  • The field shows the long name, or stops at 127 characters.

Step 14:

  • Either the field took at most 127 characters, or an inline error shows; the title keeps matrix A's name unless the 127-character name was saved.
